text:
```yaml
name: Super Linter

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release/v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release/v*'

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Super Linter
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Instrument job
        uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1

      - name: Run Super Linter
        uses: super-linter/super-linter@v8.5.0
        env:
          # The Super Linter automatically uses the GITHUB_TOKEN for status updates
          # No additional environment variables are required for basic usage
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: true
```
